Recent secondary market price dynamics

1. What do you think are the key drivers behind recent market price dynamics?

Please write your answer here
It appears the commission advise to increase unit availability has created a signal that supply is in excess so price expectations became negative causing NZU pricing to fall.

2. How do you think recent price developments should factor into the Government’s thinking about unit settings and price controls?

Please write your answer here
The price signal from the secondary market suggests there is still an excess of units & the suggestion to increase supply increases this view. It also impacts participant confidence with respect to ability to trust the settings. Government should hold to the current settings for auction volume or consider tightening further
